fusions.name: Humming Crystal
fusions.desc: Throws a raw crystal that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 30% chance of leaving the target [Exposed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Geode Burst
fusions.desc: Looses a resonant burst 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 14 arcane damage to everything in it and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ley Draw
fusions.desc: Draws on the ground beneath you, restoring 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lodestone Heart
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
